stem:
Students set up a controlled experiment by growing the same type of seedlings in two different locations. After a period of time, the students observed the seedlings and recorded their observations in the table shown.

|               | Group #1                                   | Group #2                |
|---------------|-------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| Growth Location | Enclosed in a box with a lamp on top of seedlings | On the windowsill       |
| Observation    | Shoots grow straight and upright           | Shoots bend in the direction of the window |

What caused the shoots of the seedlings on the windowsill to bend toward the window?

options.label: F
options.text: Hormones produced in response to a light stimulus

options.label: G
options.text: Sugars produced in response to a gravity stimulus

options.label: H
options.text: Carbon dioxide produced in response to a water stimulus

options.label: J
options.text: Water produced in response to a nitrogen stimulus

visual_elements: Table comparing Group #1 and Group #2 growth location and observation for seedlings
